items.title: L4.8 Governed Recurring Observation Loop Contract v0
items.description: Define the contract for a governed recurring observation loop without enabling a scheduler.
items.mission_relevance: Moves the company from manual refresh toward governed recurrence while preserving disabled live behavior.
items.selection_reason: It is the smallest safe next step after a manual dashboard refresh loop.

items.title: Add dashboard refresh review packet fixture v0
items.description: Create a Pre-U review packet fixture for recurring dashboard refresh proposals.
items.mission_relevance: Keeps future recurring refresh decisions explainable and governed.
items.selection_reason: Review packets can harden the next recurring-loop contract.

items.title: Create mission dashboard staleness indicator v0
items.description: Define a deterministic read-model field that marks whether generated dashboard evidence is stale.
items.mission_relevance: Improves autonomous situational awareness without external actions.
items.selection_reason: A staleness indicator helps the team know when refresh is needed.

items.title: Plan governed wrapper for dashboard read-only refresh command
items.description: Design a future wrapper contract for invoking refresh through governance, not as an autonomous daemon.
items.mission_relevance: Moves toward tool-mediated company operation while preserving architecture boundaries.
items.selection_reason: Useful after the recurring-loop contract defines allowed invocation boundaries.

items.title: Prepare first operator-reviewed recurrence candidate
items.description: Draft a future candidate for operator-reviewed recurring refresh without scheduling or executing it.
items.mission_relevance: Reduces founder prompting while keeping human-controlled enablement explicit.
items.selection_reason: Operator review belongs after the contract exists, not in L4.7.
